detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a properly constructed FederationConfig reports isValid() == true.

xrefdescription.para: LFC-02: FederationConfig validation — invalid epsilon rejected.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a config with dp_epsilon == 0 is rejected by isValid().

xrefdescription.para: LFC-03: Coordinator initial state — round 0, no submissions.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a freshly constructed coordinator starts at round 0 with no pending gradients and no completed delta.
Verifies that submitting a gradient for round 0 increments submittedCount().

xrefdescription.para: LFC-05: Duplicate gradient submission is idempotent.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that submitting two gradients from the same shard for the same round only counts once (idempotency contract).

xrefdescription.para: LFC-06: Multiple distinct shard submissions are counted correctly.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that two distinct shards contributing gradients results in submittedCount() == 2.

xrefdescription.para: LFC-07: triggerAggregation() throws when below min_participants.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that calling triggerAggregation() with only one gradient submitted (min_participants == 2) throws std::runtime_error.

xrefdescription.para: LFC-08: triggerAggregation() succeeds with min_participants met.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that with two gradients submitted (== min_participants), triggerAggregation() returns a valid GlobalAdapterDelta.

xrefdescription.para: LFC-09: Successful aggregation advances the round counter.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that after triggerAggregation() succeeds, currentRound() is 1.

xrefdescription.para: LFC-10: triggerAggregation() with timeout_ms=1 throws on zero-gradient round.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies timeout error handling: when no gradients are submitted and a 1 ms timeout is requested, a std::runtime_error is thrown.
Verifies that the coordinator correctly handles two sequential rounds, advancing round counter with each successful aggregation.
Verifies that GlobalAdapterDelta serialises to JSON and deserialises back with consistent field values.

briefdescription.para: Focused unit tests for LoRA federated aggregation coordination.

detaileddescription.para:
Tests the core distributed knowledge LoRA federation paths against the actual production API surface:
EncryptedGradient submission and round tracking
triggerAggregation() state machine and error conditions
FederationConfig validation and coordinator lifecycle
timeout semantics and partial-failure handling
Target: Production readiness validation for federated LoRA layer. Q3 2026 Hardening: timeout semantics, aggregation merge contracts, determinism.
